Crown Affair

The Affair Details

Pop Up Mob positioned Crown Affair just outside Sephora with The Affair Details, a pedestal-led pop-up where guests explored the brand's story through curated displays, discovered its signature scent at an interactive fragrance bar, enjoyed custom cookies, and then stepped inside Sephora to personalize their GWP pouch, turning discovery into a thoughtful, tactile ritual.
